title: Insights Workbench intake: priority lanes, tenant contracts, and export cost guardrails
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Large tenants and GA customers are requesting ad-hoc exports and customized cost breakdowns from the Console. Right now requests come in via support and CSMs and are manually triaged by the analytics squad. This causes long lead times (>2 weeks), inconsistent deliverables, and unknown cost exposure. The goal of this ticket is to define a deterministic intake and prioritization layer for the new "Insights Workbench" offering: 1) a structured ask form that translates requests into a tenant-aware data contract and deliverable template; 2) a priority-gating rubric that maps requests to delivery lanes (self-serve, SLAed batch, concierge) driven by tenant tier, data sensitivity and estimated egress/cost; 3) a small, extensible set of export templates (usage-by-route CSV, token-cost-by-model Parquet, rolling-30d-snapshot) that engineering can implement with predictable effort; 4) an estimator that returns a cost estimate and a recommended delivery lane during intake. Deliverables should reduce manual triage, set clear SLAs, and prevent unbounded cost exposure for heavy exports.
acceptance_criteria: Structured intake form prototype available in Confluence with field mappings to data contract terms (tenant, date range, export type, retention, sensitivity)
Priority-gating rubric with deterministic rules that map incoming requests to one of three lanes: Self-serve (immediate), SLAed batch (7 business days), Concierge (custom roadmap)
Three export templates defined with schema, example payloads, and cost-estimate heuristics: usage-by-route, token-cost-summary, tenant-activity-rollup
Cost estimator mock that returns an approximate compute + egress cost and suggests a delivery lane during intake
Playbook for handoffs to engineering and solutions (including required PRD/contract fields, test prompt sets, and monitoring signals)
Stakeholder sign-off from Support, Solutions Engineering, Security, and Revenue Operations recorded in ticket comments
comments: 2026-03-02 Marisol Vega: Initial discovery call with Support and two large enterprise customers (FinOps team). Reoccurring ask: tokenized cost breakdown by workspace and route, exported to Parquet. Customers want predictable SLAs and delivery windows.

2026-03-04 Ethan Brooks: Spun up a mini intake prototype in Google Forms (link in links). Need confirmation on what counts as 'sensitive' data for export lanes from Security. Blocking: KMS export policy clarity.
2026-03-06 Priya Menon (Security): Confirmed that exports may only include hashed identifiers unless customer has explicit DPA addendum. Added requirements for audit log entries on export generation.

2026-03-08 Aisha Patel (Solutions Eng): Ran three recent support tickets through the proposed rubric. Two would map to SLAed batch, one to Concierge. Suggested adding a 'workload fingerprint' field (expected row count / estimated token volume) to intake.
2026-03-10 Design review: quick wireframes for the intake flow and a compact cost-estimate preview. Design recommends a collapsible advanced section to avoid scaring self-serve users.

2026-03-11 Engineering scoping session: ENG asks for API contract for export templates and a flag to throttle export generation at runtime. Estimated backend work = 3 sprint points to implement one template and estimator endpoint.
2026-03-12 Marisol Vega: PM checklist created. Next steps: finalize rubric, author Confluence spec for templates, and open ENG ticket for estimator prototype (dependant on ENG-38210).
notes_for_engineering: Expose an endpoint that accepts an intake payload and returns: estimated rows, estimated tokens, egress bytes, recommended lane
Provide telemetry events for intake submissions (intake.submitted) and export completions (export.completed) with tenant_id and cost_estimate tags
Support an export flag to opt into hashed identifiers vs full identifiers depending on tenant contract
Implement one canonical export template end-to-end (usage-by-route) as a proof-of-concept
onboarding_playbook: Include a customer-facing template that defines data contract terms and example output
Create a Solutions Eng checklist for verifying tenant SSO/KMS requirements before scheduling Concierge lane work
Train Support on interpreting the cost-estimator output so they can set customer expectations immediately
